title: Cambridge IELTS 21 Test 3 Writing Task 2
prompt:
You should spend about 40 minutes on this task.
Write about the following topic:
All university undergraduate courses should include a period of time spent
studying abroad or doing a work placement.
Do you think the advantages of this would outweigh the disadvantages?
Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own
knowledge or experience.
Write at least 250 words.
➔ 1~ p. 1341 73
